nom: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer Face Serum SPF 60+

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the finish is light and non-greasy, though one notes a shiny finish and another avoided dimethicone-containing formulas because it worsened oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as moisturizing and lightweight, keeping skin feeling soft, though one with dry skin still developed dryness and a rash after prolonged use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it did not sting or irritate their face at all, while others with sensitive or fair-ish skin report burning, watery eyes, rashes near the nose and lips, or a reaction lasting up to a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it controls shine nicely and gave one user with combination sensitive skin no stinging, greasiness, or pilling.
segments.mature: One 37-year-old reviewer calls it the best moisturizer she has used, with no breakouts from daily use.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who mentions her age (37) reports satisfaction with daily use as a moisturizer, with no negative effects mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say the serum feels hydrating and keeps dry skin soft all day; one dry-skin user, however, reports skin felt dry within hours and developed a rash.
concerns.redness: One fair-skinned reviewer reports never getting red even with daily beach use; the eye-area burning reported by many is distinct from facial redness.
concerns.barrier: Not directly discussed beyond one report of a chemical-burn-like sensation and irritation lasting hours after washing off, without visible rash for that reviewer.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers who describe themselves as breakout-prone report no new breakouts after weeks of daily use; no reviewer describes worsening acne or blemishes from this product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report a non-greasy, shine-controlled finish, though a couple mention a slightly shiny or glowy look that some like and others find noticeable.

extraits.texte: I bought this product hoping to find a US alternative to a JP product, but this did not make the cut. First, I avoid dimethicone in all skincare as I have oily skin and it seems to make it worse. My own mistake, I didn't realize this contains dimethicone. Second, and the biggest problem, I had a severe reaction to this product. A few hours after applying (tried it two separate times) my eyes became watering and swollen. This lasted for nearly 12 hours, even after washing my face. My partner also had the same problem. Neither of us were really outside sweating or swimming. I would say I have fairly sensitive, fair-ish skin, but I also am used to a sunscreen that contains alcohol and have little no allergies otherwise.

extraits.titre: It was good for a while
extraits.texte: For the first couple weeks of using this product i enjoyed it thoroughly, other than the fact that it irritates eyes. I got around it by avoiding the eye contour area during application. As of late my skin has been reacting poorly to this product, my skin feels dry within a couple hours of application and I have developed a mild rash around my nose and lips (the most sensitive areas on my face). I really wanted to love it, but I will have to get rid of it.

extraits.titre: SPF that doesn't break me out
extraits.texte: I break out over EVERY THING, but I trust neutrogena cleansers, so I tried this. LOVE IT for daily use — been using it for 3 weeks with no break outs.

Hands down my favorite sunscreen- it's light weight, fragrance free, and not super expensive. If you have really sensitive skin give this one a try, it did not burn or sting at all. It will give you a really nice glow so I think my girls with combination skin will love it.

Personally I love this spf, I use this everyday and it hasn't broken me out! I have dry, sensitive skin, but it doesn't irritate me at all. It does look slightly greasy on the skin, but I don't mind because I have pretty dry skin. I do recommend shaking the bottle first because it can separate.

I have combination sensitive skin so sunscreen can always be a challenge. This is a great light weight product that doesn't sting my eyes, make me greasy, or pill. It was the perfect product for a humid and hot vacation.
Doesn't leave a white cast on my brown skin✨. My skin is oily and I haven't had any issues with a greasy feel to my face. Nice one to try for those new to wearing spf daily
